name: Camp Mah-Kee-Nac – Mini Mak Two-Week Sleepaway Camp
description_short: A two-week sleepaway session for boys new to Camp Mah-Kee-Nac who are entering grades 1–5. Campers live in Junior Camp cabins and do all the regular camp activities. Families can choose to extend into the full session.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim and paddle in the lake. The page does not describe swim instruction, swim tests or lifeguard staffing.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Mini Mak Two Week Sleepaway Camp

warnings: Boys only: the program is for new boys entering grades 1–5 and is not open to returning campers.
The two sessions are different lengths: Session 1 ends on a Friday (June 26–July 9) and Session 2 ends on a Thursday (July 22–August 5). Confirm the exact pickup days.
The $500 credit only applies to tuition when you register for a future full session. It is not a discount on the $6,300.
The page lists two phone numbers: 800.753.9118 in the header and 413-274-4092 in the body. The body number was recorded.
The camp also has a winter address: 2321 Chestnut Ave, Ardmore PA 19003.
unknowns: Whether spots are still open in each session
